resources.string: Whispry uses accessibility to detect the double press and hold volume button gesture to start voice recording. It does not read screen content or collect any personal data.
Changes the language Whispry\'s own screens and menus are shown in — separate from the transcription language above, which controls what language your speech is recognized as.

No need to hold the key down. Trigger once to start recording, speak as long as you like, then trigger again to stop. Respects your single/double-press choice — single mode toggles on one press; double mode needs a quick double press to start, but just one press to stop.
Trigger to start, trigger again to stop — no holding.
Press Actions (below) has taken over the trigger key — Hands-free and the hold/double-press settings here don\'t apply until you turn it off.
